The '''Capital Reclamation and Sanitation Company''' was a company that existed during the early years of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. Their [[Capital Reclamation and Sanitation Company Headquarters|headquarters]] was located in front of the [[Imperial Security Bureau/Legends|Imperial Security Bureau]] [[ISB Central Office/Legends|building]].<ref name="Imperial Commando: 501st">''[[Imperial Commando: 501st]]''</ref>
